report.mechanism: blinded re-derivation with planted-false-claim calibration, tie-broken by the claim's own settling experiment
report.blinding_design: The refuting instrument is a deterministic script that answers ten questions from the raw sources and never opens CLAIM-REGISTRY.json. Blinding is not asserted, it is MEASURED: the script wraps open/io.open/Path.open/read_text/read_bytes and records every path it touches, and a --leak run that deliberately reads the withheld file proves the audit fires. A script cannot anchor on a conclusion it has never read, so this is a stronger blinding than the instructed-not-to-look form the unit's cross-vendor arm would have used.
report.vote_counting: BANNED and not used. Every disagreement was settled by running the claim's own named experiment; where the claim named none, its verifier_probe was executed instead.
